states.name: Idle
states.quote: When the operator presses START, PLC-5 opens FV-51 and keeps it open until the level reaches 0.9 m, then closes it and enables the heater.

states.name: Filling
states.quote: When the operator presses START, PLC-5 opens FV-51 and keeps it open until the level reaches 0.9 m, then closes it and enables the heater.

states.name: Draining
states.quote: When TC-5 reports 60 degC, PLC-5 opens drain valve DV-52, which passes 0.005 m3/s when open, to discharge the hot water to the wash line until the level falls to 0.1 m.
